pages.text: The wagon climbs successive one-block steps and tilts with uneven wheel heights. Choose gentle routes with room for its width and turns.$(br2)Clearance includes canopies, cargo and seated passengers. Leave enough height in tunnels; obstacles stop the wagon.

Take care on steep slopes and cliffs. Losing front-wheel support can make the wagon slide or overturn. Try moving and steering to recover.$(br2)Hand pushing works with a reasonable posture. For a difficult recovery, dismantle with a carpenter’s hammer and rebuild on clear, level ground.
